eventDetail.scope: The 2026 International Conference on Sustainable Energy, Intelligent Systems & Advanced Engineering (SEISAE) aims to provide a premier interdisciplinary platform for researchers, academicians, and industry professionals from across the globe to present and discuss recent innovations, trends, and challenges in engineering, science, and technology with a focus on sustainability and intelligent systems. This conference emphasizes the integration of sustainable energy technologies, artificial intelligence, advanced materials, smart manufacturing, and intelligent computing to address emerging societal and industrial challenges. By fostering collaboration between the domains of Energy, Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, and Computer Science, the event seeks to promote technological advancements that drive sustainable development and Industry 4.0 transformation.
